title: GODOT from 4.4-beta4 to 4.4-stable crashes on launch with nvidia-driver-550.120.
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible on GODOT 4.4-beta4 and later (tested: 4.4-beta4, 4.4-rc4 and 4.4-stable)
- Not reproducible on GODOT 4.4-beta3 and before (tested: 4.4-beta3, 4.4-beta1, 4.4-dev7 and 4.3-stable)

### System information

Godot v4.3.stable - Linux Mint 22.1 (Xia) - X11 - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 (nvidia; 550.120) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-7400 CPU @ 3.00GHz (4 Threads)

### Issue description

GODOT 4.4 has begun to crash on launch (I cannot choose to run, edit or create projects) when using nvidia-driver-550.120 (on my end, the version appears as 550.120-0ubuntu0.24.04.1), after the driver updated to that version.
Switching that driver to nvidia-driver-535 did fix the problem, and all versions of GODOT before 4.4-beta4 run fine on the 550.120.

Btw, I'm not familiar with Nvidia's drivers (I just click update when they come), so I don't know how to try out earlier versions of that.
 And I guess this could mean that this issue should be moved to Nvidia or whoever is maintaining the ubuntu 120 version. Though no other programs (like games) have crashed. Though I will let people here choose whoever should fix this issue :P

- Make sure you are using nvidia-driver-550, version 120
- Download GODOT 4.4 stable
- Extract it and run it
